Use a bullet dot 6px at x=30. No other assets are available."},{"element_id":"s05","problem":"The article text is shifted about 1px up from the real screen ('Entertainment Weekly', title, caption and Key Points), and the bullet text is too wide (the mock text runs to the edge and the bullet dot is smaller and set closer to the text).","fix":"Move the caption and Key Points down 1px (Key Points at y=702) and use the same font width as the real screen. Place the bullet dot at x=30 and the text at x=40."}],"summary":"Score is decent, but the s33 and s13 body text is wider than the real font, which throws about 24 text boxes off by more than 4px, and the s19 body text has the same problem. The cartoon hero art is the main visual difference. This round should fix text metrics (font size, letter-spacing, line position), the 'Test Ad' height, and the hero and ad thumbnails colors."}
